notes: Scene transitions for showtime pages. kind css = transitions.js functions; kind webgl = GLSL shaders composited from the two scenes (falls back to the listed CSS type without WebGL). dur in seconds; energy: calm | medium | high; tier: premium (safe default look) | accent (use once or twice per video) | cheap (only when the style asks for it).

transitions.name: crossfade
transitions.use_when: the next shot continues the same thought; scenes share a background
transitions.avoid_when: backgrounds differ a lot (use blur-dissolve) or longer than 1 s between UI shots

transitions.name: dip
transitions.use_when: chapter breaks, before the logo, a change of place or time
transitions.avoid_when: between related points (feels like an ending)

transitions.name: blur-dissolve
transitions.use_when: the default soft handoff, especially when the two backgrounds clash

params.blur: peak blur px (default ~1.25% of width, max 24)

transitions.name: push
transitions.use_when: moving through a list or a sequence; keep one direction for the whole video

transitions.name: slide
transitions.use_when: a new card or panel covers the previous one (depth)

transitions.name: zoom-through
transitions.use_when: a state change or a new section: push into the old scene and arrive in the new
transitions.avoid_when: body text on screen (unreadable at the extremes)

params.inverse: true = pull back (reads as arriving / payoff)

transitions.name: whip-pan
transitions.use_when: fast lateral energy, B-roll bursts, beat-synced hits

transitions.name: iris
transitions.use_when: revealing from a specific point (a button, a logo, a face)
transitions.avoid_when: more than once or twice per video

transitions.name: wipe
transitions.use_when: graphic, deliberate section changes
transitions.avoid_when: diamond and bars read as template-cheap in premium work

transitions.name: glitch
transitions.use_when: a deliberate digital-error beat, once
transitions.avoid_when: on every cut; calm or premium registers

transitions.name: flash
transitions.use_when: one big hit on a music downbeat (reveal, logo)
transitions.avoid_when: more than 1-2 per video; never faster than 3 flashes per second

transitions.name: stagger
transitions.use_when: text/UI scenes on the same background: items leave in reading order, new items arrive

transitions.name: domain-warp
transitions.use_when: a signature organic dissolve: the new scene seeps in along a fractal front with an accent glow

transitions.name: ridged-burn
transitions.use_when: a film-burn style chapter change or a dramatic reveal

transitions.name: sdf-iris
transitions.use_when: opening onto the next scene from a point with a lit rim

transitions.name: ripple
transitions.use_when: flashbacks, calm or liquid themes

transitions.name: chromatic-split
transitions.use_when: a punchy tech cut on a beat

transitions.name: cross-zoom
transitions.use_when: high-energy section changes with real motion blur

transitions.name: light-leak
transitions.use_when: warm, filmic handoffs, especially over photos and footage

transitions.name: pixel-dissolve
transitions.use_when: retro or game-styled pieces

params.a: peak block size as a fraction of the height (default 0.045)

transitions.name: morph-warp
transitions.use_when: a soft liquid morph between related scenes

transitions.name: whip-blur
transitions.use_when: a whip pan with heavier, shader-grade motion blur

transitions.name: signal-glitch
transitions.use_when: one deliberate broken-signal moment

picking.rule: Pick one primary transition for 60-70% of cuts (hard cuts count) plus one or two accents. Same direction for every push. Shader transitions for 1-2 key moments (reveal, section change, logo).
